package_info.why_malicious: This report does not describe a specific malicious package or code. Instead, it outlines secure software supply chain practices and how the Sonatype Platform helps prevent the introduction and spread of malicious or vulnerable components in critical infrastructure environments.

behavioral_signatures: Quarantining of suspicious components upon download
Automated and manual review of new components before release
Continuous monitoring for new vulnerabilities in stored components
Immediate notification to stakeholders upon discovery of new vulnerabilities
file_indicators: SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) files associated with each component
Policy violation logs in CI/CD pipelines
network_indicators: Connections to public package repositories (npm, Maven, etc.)
Automated notifications to developer and security teams
Continuous monitoring calls to vulnerability databases
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor repository proxy logs for quarantined or flagged components, track SBOM generation and updates, and set up alerting for policy violations or new CVE discoveries in stored components. Use automated tools to scan for suspicious or unexpected downloads, and ensure continuous monitoring of all components for emerging threats.
